features.name: is_new_customer
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether the customer has not been contacted in a previous campaign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree models can easily split on this boolean indicator to separate completely new prospects from existing ones.

features.name: contact_intensity
features.description: Ratio of current campaign contacts to previous campaign contacts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative intensity of the current campaign compared to historical interactions, providing a continuous feature for tree splits.

features.name: housing_loan_status
features.description: Categorical grouping combining housing and personal loan status into a single integer representation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two related financial indicators into a single categorical feature, reducing the number of splits needed by the tree model to capture debt profiles.

features.name: age_group_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket for age groups (under 30, 30-59, 60 and over).
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-binned ordinal feature that simplifies tree splitting logic for non-linear age-related patterns.

features.name: contact_month_interaction
features.description: Interaction between the contact communication type and the month of the year.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures seasonal variations in communication channel effectiveness, providing a combined categorical feature for tree models.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the customer's financial stability based on job, marital status, education, default history, housing, and loan status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple categorical and financial indicators into a single ordinal score, reducing tree depth required to capture overall financial health.

features.name: recent_contact_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether the customer was contacted recently (pdays < 999).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct boolean split for tree models to isolate customers with recent historical interactions.

features.name: campaign_fatigue
features.description: Boolean indicator for customers contacted more than 3 times in the current campaign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights potential over-contacting, allowing tree models to easily identify fatigue thresholds without deep splits.

features.name: macro_economic_cluster
features.description: Semantic grouping of the macroeconomic environment based on employment variation rate, consumer price index, consumer confidence index, and euribor 3 month rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex, highly correlated macroeconomic indicators into a simplified categorical grouping that tree models can efficiently split on.

features.name: has_previous_contact
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether the customer was contacted in any previous campaign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Simple binary feature that allows tree models to immediately distinguish between completely new and historically engaged customers.

features.name: pdays_decay
features.description: Inverse decay function of the number of days since the customer was last contacted, with 0 for never contacted.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms the raw days into a bounded decay score, emphasizing recent contacts more heavily and providing a smooth gradient for tree splits.

features.name: customer_profile_complexity
features.description: Semantic assessment of the customer's demographic and financial profile complexity, evaluating the uniqueness of their combined attributes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal measure of profile rarity or complexity, helping tree models isolate niche customer segments that might otherwise require deep, complex branches.
